newsitem.title: FRANCE: French decision on Thomson seen end-Oct.
newsitem.headline: French decision on Thomson seen end-Oct.

text.p: A senior French finance ministry source said on Thursday that the government expected to reach a decision on the buyer of electronics giant Thomson SA by the end of October.
"I hope it won't go on too long," the source said, adding that he expected a decision on the bidder would be made by the end of October.

Engineering group Alcatel Alsthom and conglomerate Groupe Lagardere are rival bidders for Thomson which is being sold by the government as part of a restructuring of the French defence industry. Thomson SA owns a majority stake in defence electronics specialist Thomson-CSF.

Alcatel unveiled on Monday after months of silence its plans for Thomson which includes buying up the whole of the group, including CSF and the consumer electronics Thomson Multimedia unit, which carries around 14 billion francs of debt.
Lagardere has waged a highly public campaign in its bidding for Thomson and wants to acquire CSF and sell Multimedia to South Korea's Daewoo Electronics.
